jobs.prompt:
Create ONE original finished cover poster for the psychological horror game “心里有鬼 / YOUR OWN GHOST”. This is a dark, unsettling, moderately painterly digital illustration with found-image / photobash ambiguity, NOT polished photoreal photography or a cinematic render. Matte simplified surfaces, softly smudged edges, occasional restrained brush marks, quiet imperfect domestic architecture. The visual world feels half painted and half remembered. Low saturation soot gray, dirty olive, faded blue-gray, small bone-white highlights. Deep shadow but readable creature silhouette and space. No red clothing, no human characters, no humanoid monster, no recognizable existing monster design. No glossy CGI, no skin pores, no cinematic rim lights or fog, no all-over cracked canvas or heavy scratch texture, no concept-art ornamentation. Horror comes from a physically impossible unfamiliar organism quietly occupying an ordinary place, partial occlusion, incorrect scale, uncertainty about what is alive. No blood or gore, no jump-scare grin, no text except exact four-character Chinese title “心里有鬼” and smaller English “YOUR OWN GHOST”. Title in legible quiet ivory Song-style serif, very lightly weathered, generous spacing and margins, no blood lettering. Strong indie-game key art. SINGLE image, never a collage or grid, never a device mockup.
FORMAT: 2:3 portrait, 1024 by 1536. vertical composition. Title in the bottom 18% dark negative space, large Chinese title on one line with small English beneath.
CREATURE DESIGN: The entity is a large asymmetrical charcoal-gray arthropod-like structure, resembling an umbrella that folded incorrectly: six very thin sharply bent limbs attached to a small empty concave center, no head, no human face, no eyes, no skeleton ribs. At first its limbs look like cracks or bent furniture legs. Some limbs run along the ceiling while others descend behind furniture. Its small central hollow catches a dull bone-gray edge. Soft painterly shading obscures exact anatomy. One main organism only.
SCENE: From a low bedside viewpoint, an ordinary bedroom door and the ceiling above it. The folded organism is caught in the upper corner of the door, only four of its angled limbs clearly readable, two disappear behind the wardrobe. An edge of a plain gray blanket occupies the bottom foreground. Quiet claustrophobic vertical reach, no action.
